definitions.ask: How should a task reopened by a reply resurface for review?
definitions.why: Same resurfacing path the Gmail reply lift already uses

choices.label: Write [unblocked:: today]: it walks as TICKLER next review; no plugin change
Reopen to Ready only; it surfaces only through its existing freshness age

definitions.ask: How should the reopened task record the reply that reopened it?
definitions.why: Matches Bob's Cancel/Schedule/Rotten log convention and keeps history

choices.label: Newest-first dated entry under a 📬 REOPEN LOG child; keeps every reopen
One plain child bullet linking the latest reply, replaced on each reopen

definitions.ask: When several closed tasks link the replied thread, which should reopen?
definitions.why: One reply usually concerns the latest work; avoids reopening stale siblings

choices.label: Only the most recently closed linker; one task per reply
Every eligible closed linker of the thread

definitions.ask: Update the Gmail Task glossary strand to say closed Gmail Tasks reopen on a reply?
definitions.corrects: Every _open_ Gmail Task watches its thread
